title.zh: The Strokes 的早期纽约小场

venue.en: New York City clubs (Mercury Lounge lore & peers)
venue.zh: 纽约俱乐部（Mercury Lounge 传说与同辈场景）

summary.en: Not one stadium night—a club circuit that makes indie look dangerous before the billboards arrive.
summary.zh: 不是某一座体育馆——而是俱乐部回路，在广告牌到来前让 indie 看起来危险。

whyEpic.en: Epic here means hinge, not headcount. Mercury Lounge lore and downtown rooms turn Is This It into a city rumor that escapes into global jeans. Last Nite is a door; the rooms behind it reset cool.
whyEpic.zh: 这里的史诗指枢纽，不是人数。Mercury Lounge 传说与市中心小场，让 Is This It 变成逃进全球牛仔裤的城市谣言。Last Nite 是门；门后的房间重置了酷。

rightsNote.en: Prefer official audio over bootlegs. No unauthorized full uploads here.
rightsNote.zh: 优先官方音频，而非盗版。此处不上传未授权整场。
